giveRoleAt.title: Give the role
giveRoleAt.description: Invite: when staff invite the person (the setup link only sets their password). Completion: when the person sets their password with the setup link, or at once when they already have one; until then a new user has the default role and an existing user keeps theirs.

revealStatus.title: Tell a repeat ask what is already there
revealStatus.description: Off (private): every request gets the same answer, so nobody who types a phone number or email address learns whether it belongs to a member or has a request or invite. On: a repeat ask says already asked, already invited, setup link expired or already joined.
